sample.task:
Create a comprehensive list of 'Size Classes' that can be incorporated in a hypothetical futuristic sci-fi fantasy setting, taking place on a distant planet in which being absurdly busty is the global standard of living for everyone (even the males have huge boobs!) and is considered the epitome of attractiveness and indicator of status galaxy-wide, one's bust size being directly proportional to their prominence, with even the "flattest" of people sporting chests as big as yoga balls minimum, and the very biggest having a pair of continent-sized orbs attached to their chests; the very concept of someone being flat-chested is considered utterly taboo and hasn’t been seen or even mentioned by anyone in decades.
